contentList.content: I'm sorry. I truly am.
I can't imagine a better group of champions to have faced a big bulbous brain with.
Death will be yours and yours alone, ghaik slave. Htak'a!
I've been enjoying life. Throwing parties, making connections. And watching my old friends, biding my time...
Force Minthara to kneel along with the rest. All bow to you now.
You know, when I say it out loud, there have been decidedly more downs than ups. Almost exclusively downs, actually.
We do not need to trust one another. Just stay out of my way.
I expected some better music - can you change the song?
Yes, I'll marry you. Ideally as far away from Baldur's Gate and Cazador as possible.
Why don't you start at the beginning?
Breathe deeply and take in the scents around you.
I can't imagine hugs are all that common in the Cloister of Sombre Embrace... may I?
By the stars' light and the moon's glow, it's so good to see you, Astarion.
I hope Mizora flies into the blades of a windmill for what she did to Wyll... though I must admit the new look is a little dashing...
Finding a time and place to suit everyone might be challenging, even with my divine powers.
You're looking a bit less... 'solid' than I expected.
A little more myself than I'd like. I'm back to the shadows - back to hiding from Cazador.
It makes my stomach churn. Githzerai should be gutted, not bargained with.
Standard issue boots that may or may be modified depending on the wearer's needs. Examples include hidden knives, poison darts, and so on.
If you hadn't seen to the leaders of that goblin horde, the grove would be no more. I am in your debt.
Still pacted to Mizora, I presume.
Postcard A
I'd be happy to. But first, how have you been?
I exist not to bestow favours on my followers, but to inspire them to seize their destinies for themselves, exactly as I did. I'm their proof.
Avernus has some interesting brains to feed on, sure.
Your father must be proud of you. Have you been visiting?
Strike me and die, a failed warrior forgotten by your people.
Report User
Oh my sweet, so good of you to notice.
I've devoted myself to rebuilding the city. A life of diplomacy and compromise.
Is this the balance you wished for?
Not literally, of course - my books are not for burning. Even though some of them are inclined to combust spontaneously.
[1] has invited you to their party. Would you like to join?
Enough. We still have a war to fight.
My exploits have been limited by my new form. I live as a pariah, feared by most.
Does it do anything?
I longed for the Crown, to satisfy my own ambitions, and I was furious that it had escaped me again.
The moderation team will review your report and make a decision. Please keep in mind that this can take several days.
Let's take some time off, enjoy life. Vlaakith's forces will find us soon enough.
Avernus is my hunting ground now, but at least I have Karlach for company.
Greatclub
Of course. Perhaps the discipline of my oath will help them avoid the wayward paths of the less principled of your kind.
I smell the clean night air and a faint whiff of ale. Perfect party ambience.
The Vampire Ascendant ruling the world? That's an ambition worthy of my patronage...
Rakath and his stolen gold matter little now, perhaps we'll return if the city still stands. For now, the Brain awaits.
I never got your name.
Gourmand of Dreams
Done and done. From dust Bhaal made them, and to dust they return.
That doesn't sound like him. But whichever way you want to remember it, well done, I suppose.
Indeed.
Settling back into Waterdeep, catching up on my reading. I've even indulged in a spot of teaching...
Kiss her.
Those glowing runes - Cazador's using them to leech the others' power and take it for himself.
Until later, then.
Six Months On: Ramazith's Tower Without Its Wizard
*Before, you used to worry what lay behind those smiles. Whether they would kneel for you of their own accord, or at the beckoning of your father.*
But I see the flush in your cheeks when I speak of family. Perhaps you mean to start one of your own?
Faerûn's Own
*An invitation to a celebration, for those who stood against the Netherbrain, those who thwarted the Grand Design.*
*And besides - the hypothalamus in this brain before you is secreting.*
*Iron. Salt. A stagnant marrow-treat.*
Come on, tell all. Where have you been? What have you seen?
Candle
Rather warmer down south than it is in Waterdeep.
Letter from Mizora
*For a moment, you bask in quiet triumph. The Netherbrain is dead and the Grand Design is thwarted. But a warrior's heart is rarely still for long.*
I am surprised you aren't among my followers. I am the God of Ambition, after all.
But of course! You'll have to forgive me, I forgot to bring a shiny apple.
You are my consort, and I will see you living the very best life. Even if you don't appreciate it.
I figured Mizora would be stirring the pot at every chance. I'm pleasantly surprised.
Several Combat Encounters
Not even a whiff of fresh blood. You're such a damn tease.
That is why your victory is assured, and why it will usher in a new age for your people.
I can't. I've been away from my parents for far too long already.
Such a visit would be... impractical. I don't think so.
Manage Friends
Perhaps we should start throwing parties. But then again just attending them grants you all the fun with none of the mess...
Is that what we're doing? 'Flourishing'?
A dark deed, but a necessary one. Should it offend the gods, then they are free to descend and take a greater hand in events.
Careful, or I'll smite you.
To the greatest friends I could dream of.
Lae'zel. I knew you'd find a way.
Gold Cat Ears
I didn't think you'd take to Avernus so easily. It's a tough place to feel... well, magical.
Ha. Do not do anything that you would regret - I am, how do you say, pulling your limb.
Just 'Gale' will do nicely.
A brave choice, to kill the child of one god at the behest of another. Your loyalty plumbs darker depths than I anticipated.
I'll admit it - I miss the sounds of the wilderness at night. You simply don't get that in the city.
I suppose it's worth a try - it might keep the animals amused for a while.
Of course.
Plant
I had reservations, actually. I thought it might be too bittersweet.
Hah, you are quite coated in hamster-hair! Now wherever you go, Boo goes too.
As long as a devil doesn't put too many holes in you in the meantime.
Withers can pluck wine from all over the world, but is there one bottle of fresh blood?

I write to bring you happy news on the night of your celebration. I have completed my tour of the syndicates of the Sword Coast. Amn, Cormyr, Waterdeep, and Calimshan prove promising leads. I have communed with the illithid Nihiloor of Xanathar's Thieves Guild and made an ally of him. Through him, we will control the flow of riches through Waterdeep, and extend our influence to far north Luskan. Meanwhile, in the south, I have established 'contacts' in Calimshan - they answer wholly to me. Inland Cormyr will be the trickiest - there I believe we will have to manoeuvre around the restriction of the law, but with the right representation in our control, that too will fall to us. Make merry with your former allies, for we may yet have need of them. Keep them close, and wait for my word. Soon, my friend, neither word nor thought will traverse the Sword Coast without our knowing, nor our desire.

Until we reconvene,
The Emperor
Soldier. It's really you.
Tossed a handful of gold pieces and they scattered. A flurry of arrows dropped them before they could grab a single coin.
It is well for you that you are correct.
Gods, I remember one evening we had to eat fourteen apples, some fish heads, and a stale loaf of bread just to get by...
Perhaps I should have been the one to reach out. But you are ghaik...
Now that Karlach and I are united against Zariel's legions, Avernus burns hotter than ever.
And Mizora? Is she next on your kill list?
*That is why you must return once more to Faerûn, to be with those who stood alongside you when the Netherbrain fell.*
Aegis of the Absolute: Force
Cancel Ready
I don't get it.
No, I think it's the end. What happened to the man I once loved?
I wouldn't say no to a kiss.
People never talk about just how exhausting power can be, do they? But I'm glad the city has you as a steadying influence - just don't solve all its problems, or I'll be short of new recruits.
Mystra obliterated him - erased him from existence as if he were an error in her ledger.
Nod your head as if the word means anything at all to you.
Oh. You should not say that in polite company.
I thought you liked playing games?
You harnessed its power, as Karsus once did, and you too fell into ruin. You were halfway to heaven when the orb detonated, tearing you apart.
Go and mingle. I'll be here, darling, living my best life.
Sing a song of Balduran, if you would.
How you'd thrill in the Blade's hunt, Lae'zel. The trolls I've torn open, the ghouls I've cleaved - the stories I've been itching to tell.
I've been revelling in my freedom, rediscovering the joys of the night.
This won't be the last time. I promise.
Well, that's a relief. I didn't want to ruin a perfectly good evening by having to kill you.
Chk.
Well, she got what she deserved.
Nothing worth doing is 'easy'. If anyone has proven that, we have.
Arms Crossed
| Allow your friends who own this game on other platforms to join this play session. You must have a Larian account to use this feature. |
No platform account detected. Connect your account to see your friends.
Always, darling.
You look tired. What say we find you a home? How about with Halsin?
For the wearer who likes every ruffle and pleat just so.
I found someone who loves me, even in this form. 'Happiness' is the best word for what I feel.
Astarion! I could hug you.
I'd see Cazador, my old master, burning in the sun.

Thank you, the children shall be agog. I do believe some of them use the number of beastly fangs and claws present in a tale as the yardstick for its quality - which puts yours right at the top of the heap.
There you are, my love. Breathe deep. Can you smell it?
Padded Ottoman
I've missed travelling with you. You were a pleasure to be around.
I should hope so - imagine going through all the bother of ascending just to look dowdy.
Have you had any time to visit your father?
Is that any way to speak to the god of ambition?
You've opened the gates to every and all refugees. A wise choice, do you think?
Oh, brr!
Careful - I might not let go one of these times.
Unknown
The traitor prince will be the fall of the githyanki.
Would a fuss from me make you feel better?
You're a man of power now, Wyll. However you introduce yourself, you will always be the Grand Duke.
Wail of Loss
By Mother Gith's Blade, I wish you could join us.
Issue found while verifying state '[1]'.
Teaching magic in a classroom? A novel thought indeed. Yes, why not?
If we can reach the glowing sigils, maybe we can redirect that power from him to us.
Ah, Wyll. To see you returned to the root of yourself, with your fate in your own hands... you're yourself, but more than ever.
I have missed you too. But I understand - you're where you need to be.
I do not think there is such a thing as justice anymore, and I do not find my comfort at either end of a blade.
I won't tell a soul.
Thaniel... goodbye...
You misunderstand. I will find happiness here - I just need time to adjust.
That can't have been easy. Glad you've got backup.
I'm glad you've taken to life in Baldur's Gate so quickly. I thought you'd never leave Waterdeep...
Well. Why don't you go and mingle? That's the word, right? 'Mingle?'
Forget it. I'm finished doing other people's dirty work.
I doubt we could bore them if we tried - think of all we've gotten up to this last while!
That might prove difficult. I'm returning to Avernus with Karlach after tonight.
Translation Not Found (h432f7c84gdbe3g477cgb774g482341692c92 v1)
The pain still comes from time to time, but I won't let her torment me. I won't let her take any more from me. She's had more than enough already - now she can dwell in her beloved darkness, ignored.
Understandable. First six devils, then sixteen, sixty, six-hundred. All that remains is a trail of gore.
Can we say my Harper responsibilities to maintain balance start tomorrow?
I'm glad to hear it. Acceptance looks good on you.
I killed Cazador with the help of some friends. I'm finally free!
I've turned my mind to political concerns. We seek a powerful ally: the githzerai.
If I'd wanted you to stay I only had to say the word and you would have been back by my side. But I'm not some controlling monster.
She's kept me on a long leash, if you can believe it. Every target she's set me on's been a demonic intruder - tanar'ri assassins who slip into Avernus, armanites that amass near the Styx.
Is it me, or has it gotten a bit nippy?
My beautiful man. You've always been such a softie.
Oh hells, what? Not another adventure, is it? I'm quite content with my semi-retirement...
I was at a particularly gripping chapter of my book, but I could hardly miss this.
You almost sound like you want to go adventuring again...
Speaking of, I've got new stories to tell you. New trolls I've torn open, new ghouls I've cleaved.
I hoped I'd see you here.
Hmm, I hope that doesn't extend to me as well. But so long as your silver tongue is the only part of your mouth you put to use tonight.
... but perhaps I should have known better than to doubt. It is you we're talking about, after all. Come here, will you?
You helped seven thousand vampire spawn find safety in the Underdark. People should know that.
Leave.
She's kept me on a long leash, if you can believe it.
Reach out to Lae'zel. Seek the warmth of her touch.
Tombstone
Of course. I have complete trust in our newest allies. Xan is in fine hands tonight.
Thankfully Waterdeep has plenty of amusements on offer during the hours of darkness...
*You pray with each new heart-spillage. You worship with your diseased embrace - siring a mad legion.*
I'll take 'hello' over a fireball flung in my direction...
And yet deserve so much more.
I was always a good man.
I hoped my friends would save me...
I should probably skip the meal and nightcap, but by the gods, it would be good to rest.
Look out for me two months from now. I'll return to your arms, as surely as K'liir will forever circle the Sun.
Menyar-Ag-Gith is an ascetic. He reached out in good faith. This is his way. It is in this spirit that I must meet him.
I hoped my loved would save me...
I have ridden a red dragon to battle as a Warrior of the Comet. The lich queen Vlaakith will fall by my hand.
Go on then - convince me. Why is illusory magic so much fun?
Well, look who decided to turn up.
'The Hero and I,' no?
Obviously.
You saved a village from a rabid dire troll and have the scars to prove it. They'll believe you.
Look, Withers isn't paying me enough - or at all - to be abiding a violent audience. Strike me again and I'm gone.
If we can be discreet, I am not one to turn down a sharp mind - or an even sharper hivemind, in that case.
Paper Bubble B
She has ascended. She is beyond.
And there's another I'd like to nominate - Grand Duke of the Coast, Doom of the Dead Three.
Or as well behaved as one can be while tearing through the Hells with Karlach.
Yes, yes, absolutely essential, I'm sure.
How am I even here? I have no soul...
Of course I did - you lot could hardly manage without me.
I see you won't be claiming the domain of 'patience' in the heavens.
Being away from it... I cannot help but worry how they will fare in our absence.
I have still gathered my Bhaalian horde: an army of scented candles and bath salts.
Even though you are ghaik, you have earned the right to survive.
The owlbear cub - or well, just owlbear now. I thought you might be willing to look after him.
Halberd +2
I will join you both, and we will slay the traitorous lich queen.
In Ansur's defeat, I've found my spirit renewed. Once I've vanquished the Absolute, I will walk in your footsteps and lead the city as a Grand Duke.
The city just won't die. Like so many of us.
You look positively perfect, if a bit shimmery at the edges.
And it looks like wedded bliss is suiting you...

My friend,

I hope this finds you, wherever you are. I just wanted to thank you, and... ask a favour. I'm to be made a Watcher!! The High Harper put me forward to the Harper Council, for 'service to the city'.

I'm not sure what that means, but I know that if it wasn't for you I'd be back mucking out my mother's yard. I am permitted to bring one guest to the ceremony, who will name me Watcher before the Council.

You spoke for me once before. I understand you're probably busy - but I would be honoured if you'd do it again.

I await your reply - whenever you can! (But hopefully soon?)
Harper Geraldus
I don't know - which is just the way I like it just now. Perhaps I'll just stick a pin in a map and see what I find, or head to the docks in the morning and scrounge a berth to somewhere new.
The mighty bear is an escaped pet, then. I wonder if there is a reward for your return.
For fuck's sake, you must be half troll to have a skull that thick.
A gathering of heroes... a fine target for our enemies.
Bah, Boo does not believe your bitter words!
Ah, a sensible pastime indeed. You must tell me all about it sometime. I'm sure I'd find it fascinating.
You've got it all wrong. I am in it for the glory.
Thirteen kith'raki, twenty-five sarths, and three-hundred-five warriors. Precisely.
I yearn to kill. Specifically, a girl with the 'sweetest face of the moon'.
We'd both love to see you more, Tara. Why not pop through that catflap of displacement of yours, and pay us a visit?
Y
I've devoted myself to the hunt. The Sword Coast must be cleansed of its monsters.
We have forsaken our tasks in the Wyrmway and won't be able to return.
Luckily for both of us, I'm well-versed in stealth. Come here...
Kill with one last kiss.
Pact of the Blade: Maul
Oh, do not fear them - there's no point in fearing the inevitable.
I see Mystra didn't smite you in the end...
I wasn't sure our withered old friend could live up to his promise, but here we are.
Waving: Polite
More's the pity. In that case, I doubt we shall ever meet again.
Smiling may no longer come easy to you, but I've seen how your tentacles twitch at my jokes. Even the ones I'm not entirely certain I was trying to make...
I suppose it is, rather. I'm just glad to be here at all.
You must have a favourite, yeah? A fight you still savour?
She battled in Avernus, fuelled on naught but hope. And that hope came to become truth.
Tonight is for celebration, not worrying about Vlaakith's petty thugs.
Bah.
Gods, it's so good to see you. It's been far too long.
I killed Cazador with the help of some friends. I'm finally free!
A small wicker basket, redolent with the musk of fresh cabbage.
Study
The last words of an infamous githyanki heretic, publicly executed generations ago by Vlaakith LXXIV.
There's only one devil hunt I'm interested in hearing about. Have you slain Mizora?
Still, at the very least you must come visit me. I've a pantry full of Waterdhavian delicacies and a delightful bottle of Elverquisst with your name on them...
I suppose, if I were to open a contained portal in a particularly safe region of Avernus...
*You waste no time in packing, and set off on the long road back to where all of your adventures together began.*
A trap. Let us send forth our least favourite, to be sure.
Nobody is dying tonight.
Instinctive Charm
It will take a while for me to gain full control.
*You cast your lot with the Emperor. Turning your back is no longer an option. What shall it be?*
All about you, of course. 'Every day's an adventure when I'm at my love Gale's side', I'll tell them.
Your 'ambition' didn't earn you these powers. I did.
Now the Blade of Frontiers is a ranger - a true hunter of monsters, a warden in more than just name.
I found the love of my life. I'd say I'm pretty happy.
Hells! Is this the Absolute's doing?
You could have dominated the Netherbrain and given me all of Faerûn. This is a bargain by comparison.
I don't think it was.
If Mizora lets you off her leash, that is.
Minsc no longer answers to the Stone Lord - and the dead do not walk. Allow my hamster to show you.
I may be a Grand Duke. But I promise, I am still the same Wyll you always knew, old friend.
Now go - mingle, carouse, indulge.
I owe no amends. You're on your own.
I should have killed you when I had the chance...
*Time has passed since you claimed your godhood, but you cannot say how much. A day, a month, a year, a century?*
The Weave floweth not in this place of shadows, Gale of Waterdeep, but thine heart singeth in its place.
Our fight continues apace, though it will take time to topple a powerful queen like Vlaakith.
May I have a hug?
I have a little cottage now - it's close to my parents and has room for all the animals I've taken in.
Don't make me regret my decision.
If that's the criteria for choosing a domain, you should be the God of Wasting Valuable Loot.
I will not hesitate when the time comes.
You know me. Neck deep in devil guts and demon blood until I find a permanent way out.
I have adjusted to my new form - come to enjoy it, even.
Withers has surpassed himself with the musical accompaniment for the evening - I had feared things might be a touch more sedate, out here in the wilderness.
We're a couple - it's our duty to bore them to tears with details of our adorable home life.
Deity
The First Protocol
There's every need. If I pretended you hadn't turned tail on every lesson you set out to learn, I'd have no right to call myself your friend.
How is your father holding up? He's keeping the Flaming Fist in line, I gather.
On my part, at least. They did have to tear out his tongue before I could approach safely, but we got there in the end. And what a glorious end it was.

Hello petal,

I gave birth to Vanra - or Auntie Vanra, I should say. She fought me the whole way, too, bless her. I told her all about you, and she can't wait to meet her new godparent.

Gosh, they grow up so fast, don't they?

Between her, and Mayrina's brat, I have myself a nice little coven. We're laying low for now, of course - I don't want my girls getting overwhelmed too soon. But in time, they'll make their debut, and the Sisters of the Seeing Pearl will be whole once more.

And it's all because of you.

Lots of love,

Auntie Ethel

P.S I've been alive for a very, very long time, and I have only one regret - that I didn't climb you like a tree when I had the chance x
True. They might even be jealous of the bucolic life. Perhaps every adventurer secretly pines for a little flower strewn cottage overrun with animals...
Alas, not every deal with a devil works out as well as it did for me.
I wouldn't have missed the chance to see my old friends again.
They seem less frequent - do you think she might be losing interest?
Gods, love - I must look a mess. I'd just rolled out from under a pesky ogre when Withers yanked me in.
I've gotten quite good at replicating your signature, so you needn't even bother with the release form.
Just keep safe - don't do anything I wouldn't.
To all of you, my real family.
You have something of mine. The Crown of Karsus.
What has become of the egg, Lae'zel? Has it hatched?
My ambitions require no god to aid them. I need no more than my own wiles to slay Vlaakith's assassins.
It's just not especially interesting, that's all. I was really hoping for some sex or violence. You know: something fun.
First I must find the sneak-thief, and educate him on the company he keeps.
Till next we meet, remember: Thou gave all thou wert to save lives, to reclaim the world from a fate most dire.
Well, never mind that. By the stars' light and the moon's glow, it's so good to see you, Astarion.
Yes, join me. We'll face him together.
Gustav
My love, my Hells-wanderer!
But dammit all, you are too bold a soul to be slinking in shadows, tentacles or not.
I'm quite happy with the status quo. Enjoy your evening, and don't talk about bark and moss too much.
*Half a smile shows he is teasing you. He doesn't think for one moment you'd fully submit to him, nor should a Spawn as formidable as you.*
I wouldn't say no to a kiss.
I won't pretend I'm not a little jealous. Lady Shar is a demanding mistress - as is her right to be - but a little calm and solitude would be a tonic.
Do that and I'll cast an infestation on you, and acquaint you with a whole new set of parasites.
Let's take things down a notch, shall we? She's no devil, Wyll. You'll have to look elsewhere to find fodder for your blade.
Excellent. It will save me the effort of sneaking in under a false name. It is tiresome to masquerade before the ball even begins.
The bond we share remains deeply precious to me, all the same.
Kiss her.
Myself included - we have all shared in this bounty. But I take your point, and shall acknowledge my role. In brief.
You will learn this, or you will die.
The best choice for the job. Your tongue is as learned as your blade.
Not quite. But luckily Selûne allows you to forge your own path. Perhaps I'll be drawn to her, perhaps not. Either way, I get to decide. That's not something I was ever able to claim before.
Quiet is not always peace - that much I can vouch for. But in your case - I think you deserve a moment's rest.
It is worth as much as the law dictates.
Oh, Tara. It hurts to be so misunderstood by my oldest friend.
Sounds wonderful.
Mage Hand
*The sacks of unclaimed blood cheer one another, while you, thorn-pricked pile of nothing, leer.*
Evil never lasts. Someone will stop you.
My 'ambition' is to have a little cottage, my parents, and a host of animals to keep me company. I've already fulfilled that, without your help.
We deserve a special night - my parents were practically shooing us away. Let's enjoy ourselves.
You will become a legend.
*An invitation, written in a frail hand, inviting you to a celebration for those who stood against the Absolute.*
I finished it. Using the Crown of Karsus I turned it into a new form of magic, fused with my being, driven by my purpose. And then I put it to work.
I've been at something of a loose end - roaming and adventuring as I see fit.
We have something in common after all. Ambition.
I've missed you, you old Bhaalspawn. Oh - do you not want me to call you the B-word any more?
It's good to see you too, Minthara.
Display Case
I'd give the artefact to you freely, but it isn't possible.
I'm not in the habit of praying, but I may make an exception for you, Dekarios.
Lae'zel Alien Emoji
Failed to modify UI State
Pose Variant
Your words may feign indifference, but I can only assume they are a facade behind which your true heartbreak is keenly felt.
I am sworn to help any law officer. Say the word.
Tombstone
Square Bubble A
Grand Duke Ravengard died when the Iron Throne was destroyed. We should talk to Mizora; maybe there's something she can do.
These padded vambraces balance light protection with a dextrous expression impossible in heftier gauntlets.
But it would make everything so much easier.
My home is with Gale.
The Upper City has been almost entirely rebuilt - that's where the gold is. Even the builders' scaffolds are cleared from the streets. No dust left to sneeze at.
If those blueprints work, I could reverse engineer my stone eye. Instead of Mizora tracking me, I could track her.
It was at that moment, the Weave connecting us, that I realised how much your friendship had come to mean to me. As it still does.
I thought you'd got past this 'sleeping outdoors and getting smoke in your robes' phase, but here we are once again.
Cat Face
The aura of Netheril hangs heavy on you. What deal did you strike to claim Karsus's powers like this?
I suppose you'll want a hug or something.
Gale sacrificed himself to save the realms by detonating the Netherese Orb.
Look after yourself, Jaheira. I hope you can rest soon.
Those runes are siphoning power to Cazador.
I embraced my hellish side and dedicated my life to rebuilding the grand city of Baldur's Gate.
Hm. I'm not noticing anything special.
Nngh. The thought of you sweaty from battle - It is all I can do not to ravish you, here and now. Perhaps we might find time later for a bit of... indulgence.
I thought I was your people.
I'm wise enough to know I'm never too far from your watchful gaze, Tara...
Ha! Oh they are welcome to try. I could use a new trophy for my wall.
I'm just delighted at the chance to enjoy a party without fearing I'll have killed someone by the end of it.
A trap. As if we are a horde of dumb-footed duergar.
No Chin attachment
A duck whittled out of wood. It smells of the deep forest.
Astarion! Cured of one affliction, only to be reclaimed by another. The sun is no longer a friend to him, but we must be - he'll need more solace than shadows can provide.
Nothing is a sure thing. Try not to get your hopes up, soldier.
I was hoping you might like a new companion - rather large, feathered, well-mannered, mostly...
